constructorFindings: SessionValidator has no constructor; its class load declares methods/constants and empty per-instance cache defaults.
DataService, ArenaService and ArenaEvidence constructors only promote typed properties; no SQL, receipt capture, session or lock operation occurs in these current constructors.
consumerFindings: ArenaService uses validator/data only when constructing ArenaEvidence in the submit branch.
ArenaEvidence always needs a validator for candidate and authoritative replay; DataService is consumed only by an unquarantined finish commit.
All other non-Arena consumers in index.php must retain the current validator/data path, including public student routes and request-receipt capture for sessions/social duel-submit.
requiredPreservedOrder: One server receipt before candidate validation and locks
Member update and eligible finish persistence in the same transaction
requiredGuards: Explicit nullable typed constructor parameters/properties where omitted; no passing null to current nonnullable signatures.
Fail closed before a validator or persistence dependency is consumed; never use nullsafe calls to silently omit replay or commit.
Strict finish===true allocation decision; malformed nonboolean finish retains the existing arena-candidate422 path.
One validator instance reused for prepare and locked replay, preserving request-local cache lifetime.
Do not move server receipt capture into constructors or factories or alter locked-error precedence.
Retain non-Arena service allocation behavior and preserve all DataService captureRequestReceipt consumers.
risks: Skipping an unused class load changes file-load/parse failure precedence for a broken deployment; normal candidate evaluation must assume the independently checked complete release artifact.

Nullable signatures alone are not proof that PHP avoids autoloading on the fast branch. A controlled class-loader count/class_exists(name,false) contract should establish this without loading private configuration.
A client finish flag can choose which dependency is allocated, but it cannot grant a finish or bypass boolean/canonical/clock/member validation.
